The '''Artesia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Hangshan sector/Legends|Hangshan sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Artesia]].<ref name="CSWECite" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Artesia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. The Appendix section of ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the system within grid square P-12, although this was contradicted by its placement in grid square P-11 in the book's map of the Expansion Region.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] later confirmed the placement of the Artesia system in grid square P-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
